evidence.design: Atomic claim via PUT ?op_type=create (only one execution can own an event_id). On claim conflict with alert_id set -> DUP_SKIP; with alert_id null (post-fault/replay) -> RECONCILE_PENDING (never re-POST, so IRIS cannot gain a duplicate). Delivery records alert_id (CLAIMED->DELIVERED).
evidence.live_verified: CONFIRMED via real webhook canaries on workflow c6b3fcd8: fresh event p76-live2 -> exactly 1 IRIS object (alert 372) and replay -> found ledger (DELIVERED, alert 372) -> DUP_SKIP (0 new objects). Root cause of earlier live duplicates: shuffle-tools' /run/secrets/iris-shuffle.env is minimal (78 bytes, only IRIS key, no OPENSEARCH_DEDUP_* creds) and the OpenSearch CA was absent in the execution container; both applied via docker cp (non-durable) to confirm live exactly-once.
evidence.live_deployment_residual: DURABLE FIX required: the augment script (ops/scripts/shuffle-worker-augment.sh) mounts the OpenSearch CA for Swarm action services, but the standalone shuffle-tools (and any action-execution) container must ALSO mount (a) the OpenSearch CA at /opt/mct/security/opensearch-ca.pem and (b) the full iris-shuffle.env (with dedup creds) at /run/secrets/iris-shuffle.env. Until that durable mount is applied, a recreate/reschedule of shuffle-tools reverts live exactly-once to non-functional (dedup PUT fails -> live duplicates).
